review: CLAUDE.md#전체 공통 규칙 1~9 (권한은 서버, 위험 조작은 기기 페이지만, 비상정지 금지, 연결 끊김 표시, 값 규칙, 기기 ID 고정, 화질 3단계, 가정값은 app/src/config)
작업한 폴더의 CLAUDE.md 규칙을 따랐는가 (app/src/studio/는 그 폴더의 고정 규칙 여섯 가지 + 공통 규칙 1~6·8·9·7)
API 형식 변경은 명세 → shared → mock-server → app 순서이고 docs/dashboard-spec.md와 1:1인가
명세 6절 권한 표와 app/src/test/permissionMatrix.ts가 줄·✓✗까지 같은가
docs/ 는 메인 AI와 사용자만 수정 — 작업 단위가 docs/를 고쳤으면 되돌리고 PR 본문에 필요한 수정을 적게 한다
카메라 조작 범위(부지 밖 이동, ±35도 초과 회전, 자유 회전·핀치 확대 금지), 토큰을 URL에 넣지 않음
UI 변경은 해당 점검 스크립트(app/scripts/*.mjs, CLAUDE.md 명령어 표)를 돌리고 스크린샷을 PR에 첨부; 스크립트를 추가·변경했으면 CLAUDE.md 명령어 표 수정 필요를 PR에 적는다

extra: Read CLAUDE.md and the CLAUDE.md of every folder you touch before editing. docs/dashboard-spec.md is the single source of truth; if the implementation must differ from it, stop and report instead of changing code.
Do not edit docs/. Put needed doc/decision changes in the PR body under '문서 수정 필요'.
Commit titles: <type>(<area>): <Korean summary>, e.g. fix(robot): 수동 투입을 배치 배합에 반영. Code identifiers in English, comments in Korean.

No GitHub Actions CI: run the local verify commands and paste totals in the PR body. Browser checks (test:integration, app/scripts/*.mjs) need local Chromium; run them alone, not in parallel. If Windows reserves port 4099 use INTEGRATION_PORT=4399.
Do not decide open questions (docs/questions.md); proceed with the prototype assumptions in docs/dashboard-spec.md.

Loop speed (workflow.json "loop"): in intermediate rounds run typecheck/test plus ONLY the browser checks whose paths match the files changed in that round (loop.browserChecks), with the short env (loop.intermediateEnv); run the full verify set and every matching browser check with full durations only in the final round before reporting. Do not skip browser checks; scope them.

review: Round 1 review must list EVERY problem it can find against all criteria at once (not one area per round).
S3 polish items (wording, a few px, colour shade) do not trigger a new round: record them and the implementer fixes them together with the next required fix or in the final round.
Later reviews check only the failed criteria plus a regression pass on the files changed since the last review, using the screenshots the implementer already produced.
loop.designFirst: For phases whose result is mostly layout/visual (3D scene, page layout): before the full implementation, the implementer produces one sketch (coordinates drawing or a single screenshot) and the reviewer (or the user, if the phase prompt says so) approves it; then build.
